notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
[list][*][p]Deactivated the background menu video for optimization reasons[/p][/*][*][p]Extended the fade-in duration tohide level loading[/p][/*][*][p]Added fences to the alley for scene blocking[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted some props[/p][/*][*][p] Decals adjusted[/p][/*][*][p] Collision bug in container fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Fuse bug when replaying game fixed[/p][/*][*][p] Added a collision sphere to query collision with the level streaming volumes so when the player clibs the level does not get unloaded.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed boxes cinema room 2 + added two cinema chairs[/p][/*][*][p]Climing animation unloads levels as it probably moves the player outside the volumen -[/p][/*][*][p]Added a collision sphere to query collision with the level streaming volumes so when the player clibs the level does not get unloaded.[/p][/*][*][p] Level organized[/p][/*][*][p] Level Streaming volume added and ready.[/p][/*][*][p] Seesaw bug fixed. Before the square. No longer the player gets stuck between the seesaw and the container.[/p][/*][*][p] Cameras fixed: Parking entrance camera would bug if you entered the collider from the rear. Also after the fall in Parking 1. Camera would get cover by a wall if you moved near the walls.[/p][/*][*][p]The decals of some pushable boxes fixed so that they don't get applied to other surfaces.[/p][/*][*][p]Added some obstacles to some colums as a excuse to not be able to get back.[/p][/*][*][p] Added wood planks to the car at the first puzzle in Parking 2 so that it is understandable that you cannot climb the car.[/p][/*][*][p]Moved the car and colum of the second puzzle in Parking 2 to prevent jumping and get better visibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Added moss assets at some points[/p][/*][*][p]Illumiated the spawn point of the first hand on the stairs.[/p][/*][*][p]Blocked with obstacle the small corridor on the cinema.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed first post of the fence at the cinema.[/p][/*][*][p]Z fighting issues fixed at the rooftops background.[/p][/*][*][p]Student game disclaimer added. 
[/p][/*][/list]
